verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The headline has lost its yellow backing block. That block ends up stranded over the top hero photo, so it reads as an empty, unrelated shape. The second photo is cropped into a narrow strip beside a large blank yellow slab. The black 'Online training by' / 'Freya Anouk' bars are small, sit apart from each other and are not aligned with the headline's left edge. A is slightly worse: its two separate yellow bars float over the hero photo like blank text boxes, so it looks like text is missing, while B's merged yellow shape at least reads as a deliberate frame element.
